cfg.subModeListHint: “By whitelist” — only whitelisted vehicles with a valid licence get in

cfg.recognitionHint: What counts as a usable plate. A plate that fails the check never opens the barrier — the read is logged as a recognition error.
cfg.minConfidenceHint: A plate passes only if the camera read it at or above the selected percentage. Start at 80% and watch the log: if recognition errors pile up, lower the level.

cfg.allowReentry: Allow a vehicle that is already inside
cfg.allowReentryHint: A repeated entry usually means a duplicate read or a second car tailgating on someone else's plate. Enable only if the exit camera often misses drive-outs.
cfg.flowEntryExitHint: Cameras handle both directions: the exit camera closes the session and frees the space by itself.
cfg.flowEntryOnlyHint: Cameras register entries only. Exits are closed by the operator — from the parked-vehicles list or at the cash desk.
